title: Exceptional integral scalar mates: core data before ramified witness
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sf-exceptional-integral-scalar-mates, there exist Mates data, reduction mates at every finite level, and SystemMates data for every integral coefficient extension; the final existence of an explicit ramified index witness is omitted.

source.place: Lemma 5.22 and Proposition 5.26; the non-index clauses of the integral scalar construction.

proof.text: Construct the finite and integral scalar mates by the ten-step system transport, reconstruction, and proper/open realization argument of the parent node, stopping before the independent arithmetic ramified-index witness.

proof_origin: split from the parent theorem by stage-3 worker Z5

from.place: The first three clauses of the conclusion, before the final explicit ramified witness.

lean.statement:
theorem exceptionalIntegralScalarMates_core
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [QuasiCompact f] (c : Compactification f)
    (operation : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l, Operation.{u} l Ω X Y (s.stage l))
    (left : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l, LeftRealization.{u} l Ω c s (operation s))
    (transport : Transported l Ω D hl c operation left) :
    ∃ d : Mates l Ω c operation left,
      ∃ red : ∀ (E : FieldStage.{u} l) (n : ℕ),
        ReductionMates l Ω D hl c operation left transport d E n,
      ∀ (E L : FieldStage.{u} l) (i : E.carrier →ₐ[Padic l] L.carrier),
        Nonempty (SystemMates l Ω D hl c operation left transport d red E L i)
